description: This file defines test configurations and reference implementations for FFT-related operations in PyTorch, including SpectralFuncInfo subclasses, error sample generators, and operator database entries for FFT functions.

classes.name: SpectralFuncPythonRefInfo
classes.description: A subclass of SpectralFuncInfo for Python reference operations, linking to torch opinfo and handling constructor args.

methods.name: error_inputs_fft
methods.description: Generates error sample input for zero-dimensional tensor FFT.

methods.name: error_inputs_fftn
methods.description: Generates error sample input for FFTN with invalid dimension.

methods.name: sample_inputs_fft_with_min
methods.description: Yields sample inputs for FFT operations with minimum size, considering ROCm support.

methods.name: sample_inputs_fftshift
methods.description: Yields sample inputs for fftshift and ifftshift with various shapes and dims.
